introductions.title: 大事♡いつも聞いてくれてありがとう

body.intro:
普段、無料で投稿しているASMRや音声を
「保存していつでも聴きたい」「サイト上だとダウンロードできなくて困る」
という方向けに、DLsiteでも作品をまとめています]

音声は基本5分～15分が多いです
自宅で撮っている為、車の音などが入っています。
受けが良ければ1時間～2時間の長いものをDLサイトで
販売したいです?

基本的には、普段無料で公開している音声を
ダウンロードして手元に残したい方向けのページです。

「あとで聴こうと思ったら見つからなくなった」
「通信環境を気にせず聴きたい」
「寝る前にオフラインで流したい」
「お気に入りの音声を保存しておきたい」

そんな時に使ってもらえたら嬉しいです。

もちろん、DLsite限定の作品や長時間作品なども、
これから少しずつ増やしていく予定です♡

普段無料で聴いてくれている方は、
無理に購入しなくても大丈夫です。

「保存したいな」
「活動をちょっと応援したいな」
と思ってくれた時に利用してもらえたら、それだけでとっても嬉しいです。

れいきらの音声を、
好きな時に、好きなだけ。

あなたの端末の中にも、
小さな“秘密基地”を作ってもらえたら嬉しいな

※無料公開中の作品については、公開先でそのまま無料でお楽しみいただけます。
※こちらは主にダウンロード・保存を希望される方向けの販売ページです。
※作品によってはDLsite限定・有料限定の内容を含む場合があります。

I’ve put together some of the ASMR and audio content that I usually share for free and made it available on DLsite for those who would like to download and keep their favorite recordings.

This page is especially for people who think:

“I want to save these audios and listen to them anytime.”
“I can’t download them from the original site.”
“I want to listen offline before going to sleep.”

Most of the audio tracks are around 5–15 minutes long.

Please note that these recordings are made at home, so you may occasionally hear background noises such as cars passing by.

If these releases are well received, I’d also love to create and sell longer ASMR works of around 1–2 hours on DLsite in the future ♡

Basically, this page is mainly for those who want to download and keep the audio that I normally share for free.

Maybe you’ve experienced something like:

“I was going to listen to it later, but I couldn’t find it anymore.”

“I want to listen without worrying about my internet connection.”

“I want to play it offline before going to sleep.”

“I want to keep my favorite audio saved on my device.”

If that sounds like you, I’d be very happy if you use this page ♡

Of course, I’m also planning to gradually add DLsite-exclusive content, longer ASMR works, and other special releases in the future.

If you already enjoy my free content, please don’t feel like you have to purchase anything.

If you ever think,

“I’d like to keep this one.”

or

“I’d like to support Reikira’s activities a little.”

then choosing to purchase it would make me very happy ♡

Reikira’s voice, whenever you want, as many times as you want.

I hope you’ll create your own little “secret hideout” inside your device, filled with your favorite Reikira audios ♡

Please note:

※ Works that are currently available for free can still be enjoyed for free on the platforms where they are originally posted.
※ This page is mainly intended for those who would like to download and save the audio files.
※ Some releases may include DLsite-exclusive or paid-exclusive content.

description: I have a lot of listeners from overseas, so I made this to practice my English! I hope my English is okay… Sorry if I’m not very good at it yet. I love you guys so much! ♡
